notes:
Contact: Lina Park (Head of Product) + Marcus Holt (Eng mgr). Mid-market SaaS that builds in-app onboarding copilots (guided flows + step-by-step task helpers). Primary asks: predictable latency for real-time flows (streaming responses), tool-calling reliability (3rd-party product data fetch), and strict token cost caps for in-app monthly quotas. They want quick dev integration — prefer hosted API initially; likely move to Dedicated once POC proves SLOs and unit economics.

Key quotes / call snippets:
- "We need streaming that feels instant in the UI — 200ms median, 350ms p50 target for typical prompts; tail matters." — Lina Park
- "Token spend is our primary risk. If we can't cap cost per user, ROI disappears." — CFO (on call)

POC notes: instrumented per-session token counters, integrated function/tool calling to demo product lookup and in-app links, added prefix caching for repeated onboarding steps. Observed higher token usage with long histories; experimenting with condensed context + per-user summary caching.

Security: asked for KMS envelope flow, audit log examples, and data residency writeup. Legal wants confirmation that logs containing PII can be scrubbed/retained per policy.

Commercial: leaning hosted API for speed; cost sensitivity means we should model Dedicated commit options with burst and auto-failover to hosted to keep UX consistent. Provided example pricing deck (drive).

Internal AE notes: push for a 6-month Dedicated pilot if POC confirms 99th pct latency and we can show 25-35% lower token cost via caching/quantization recommendations. Keep SE Diego close for batching kernel recommendations.
